shots.title: Cliff gaze
shots.goal: Establish Wukong above the cloud sea before the oath.

segments.label: Wide reveal
segments.prompt: A slow aerial push toward Wukong standing on the Flower–Fruit Mountain cliff. Sunset cloud sea, banner cloth moving in the wind, restrained cinematic motion.

segments.label: Resolve to profile
segments.prompt: Continue from the wide reveal into a calm profile close-up. Keep armor, golden headband and sunset key light consistent with the shared portrait state.

shots.title: Banner rises
shots.goal: Turn the oath banner into the scene's visual motif.

segments.label: Hands and staff
segments.prompt: Low angle detail: Wukong drives the staff into stone as the oath banner rises behind him. Sparks, dust and heavy cloth motion.

segments.label: Banner crest
segments.prompt: The camera cranes upward with the banner until its crest fills the frame, then eases back to reveal the gathered monkeys below.

shots.title: Oath circle
shots.goal: Build collective energy while preserving character identity.

segments.label: Circle enters
segments.prompt: A circular dolly reveals the companions stepping into an oath circle around the planted staff. Preserve wardrobe and spatial continuity.

segments.label: Hands converge
segments.prompt: Hands converge above the staff. The first render drifts on hand anatomy; ReCA branches to a repaired close-up with clearer silhouettes.

segments.label: Energy pulse
segments.prompt: A gold energy pulse travels from the joined hands into the staff and across the rock floor, lighting every face in sequence.

shots.title: Sky vow
shots.goal: Close on the shared vow and a final heroic silhouette.

segments.label: Cloud break
segments.prompt: The cloud ceiling breaks above the circle; warm light sweeps down the cliff while the camera rotates toward the open sky.

segments.label: Hero silhouette
segments.prompt: End with Wukong and the banner in silhouette against the opened sky. Hold the final composition long enough for the title beat.
